Pressing an item in desk-review's report now lands on its line in the Changes tab, even when that line is outside the diff.

- desk-look: when desk-review opens a file at a line, the eight lines on either side are read from the file (or from the commit shown) and unfolded, whether they sit in a folded run of unmodified lines or after the last change, where the diff showed nothing. The line's number is marked and the pane scrolls to it
- desk-review: pressing an item sends its line along with its file
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.73.3 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
